turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, so let's start with the zero. Who decided to enter it, and did anyone speak to Owen first?
Over with isn't an answer, Hale. I asked who entered the zero and whether Owen was heard first. I'm writing down how you respond.
Look, your son cheated. Everyone knows it. I'm not wasting my evening on this.
"Everyone knows it." Who is everyone, Hale, and what document are they reading? My son does not lie, and I'm writing down that you called him a cheater with nothing in front of me.
You lawyers think you can bully anyone.
I haven't raised my voice, Hale. I've asked three questions and you've answered none of them. Is there a document, or am I going to the principal's office?
Are you going to keep wasting my time?
Wasting your time? You entered a zero without calling me, and Owen found out on his phone in the middle of class. Show me what you have, Hale, or I'm done here and going upstairs.
